body.x: More than 160 technology companies based in the Midwest region of the United States (Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, Nebraska, North Dakota, Ohio, South Dakota and Wisconsin) will showcase their latest consumer electronics products at the 2012. International CES. Owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the 2012 International CES, the world’s largest consumer technology tradeshow- which will feature more than 2,700 exhibitors across 1.7 million net square feet of exhibit space - is scheduled for Tuesday, January 10-Friday, January 13 in Las Vegas, Nevada.

CES will feature more than 25 market-specific TechZones, including four new destinations: Eureka Park, with innovative start-up companies and entrepreneurs looking to gain a footing in the industry; G.hn, featuring demonstrations of a suite of technologies by the International Telecommunications Union specification’s (ITU-T) member companies; MEMs, showcasing companies that are driving the adoption of wireless technology in mobile phones, game consoles, tablet PCs and other hot consumer electronic devices; and PMA@CES, which will feature the most-concentrated exhibits of digital imaging/photography products and services.

“We are putting ‘the D’ on the map at the largest consumer technology tradeshow in the world showing how southeastern Michigan is more than just car manufactures,” said Jake Sigal, founder and CEO of Livio Radio in Ferndale, Michigan.

The 2012 CES is bringing back CES’ fastest growing TechZone, the iLounge Pavilion, with more than 300 iLounge exhibitors spanning two locations in both the North and South Halls of the LVCC. The highly trafficked CEPro@CES, Gaming Showcase, Go Electric Drive, Location Based Services, Safe Driver, Sustainable Planet and Wireless Mobility Brought to you by QualcommTechZones highlight the latest in cutting edge technology. Plus lifestyle TechZones will be featured: Digital Health, HigherEdTECH,Kids@Play, Mommy Tech, Silvers Summit and Sports and Fitness.

“We are proud to introduce our newest certifications: Electric Vehicle Technician (EVT), Gaming and Vending Technician (GVT), Precision Optics Technician (POT), Photonics Technician Operator (PTO), and Passive Intermodulation Testing (PIM) at the 2012 International CES,” said Teresa Maher, president, Electronics Technicians Association International (ETA), based in Greencastle, Indiana. “With the reputation for being a cutting-edge consumer tech show, CES is the perfect venue for introducing these new certifications in emerging technologies. We invite you to stop by the ETA International booth #5007 for more information on these certifications.”
For more information on the 2012 International CES: CESweb.org.
